messages:
mia: Noticing a surprising spike: some tenants got charged for both v1 and v2 during our staged switch. Quota counters doubled for single requests. Anyone seen traces?

dan: saw same on alert. looks like fallback attempts emit billing events before route finalization.

mia: sample: 
```
proxy: X-Api-Version: v2 -> attempt v2 -> fallback v1
billing: charge tenant/987 +200 (v1)
billing: charge tenant/987 +200 (v2)
```

clare: billing dedupe keys on request_id but proxy regenerates ids on fallback. we need a stable per-client signature.

dan: two options: 1) delay billing until router emits final_route, or 2) make a compat_sig that is stable across fallback attempts and dedupe on it.

mia: delaying billing breaks proxy quota enforcement unless we add sync quota checks. That's risky. prefer compat_sig + dedupe in billing. Shadow-run first.

clare: agree. also add a console metric and tenant badge for "compat dedupe hits" so support can see affected accounts.

ops-bot: scheduled: enable billing-dedupe-shadow in staging -> 2026-03-22T09:00Z

d an: will implement compat_sig in proxy; key = hash(tenant_id + client_nonce + path + model). avoid any PII.

mia: please add a small CI test that simulates v2 timeout then fallback to v1 and asserts single billed increment in shadow mode.

finance-bot: FYI Finance wants a weekly report if shadow shows >$100 delta.

clare: tasks: proxy sig (dan), billing dedupe + shadow (clare), console badge (mia), tests (dan+clare).

mia: ok, let's run shadow for 72h and reconvene. thanks all. :thumbsup:
